title: Royal Court Wisdom
summary: Royal courts gathered counselors, scribes, officials, and teachers whose wisdom affected judgment, diplomacy, and national life.
background: Ecclesiastes, Proverbs, Daniel, and royal narratives show wisdom being tested in court settings where truth, justice, and fear of the Lord mattered more than clever speech.
teachingHelp: Connect court wisdom to the greater wisdom of Christ, who is wiser than Solomon and rules with perfect righteousness.
